messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning to roll out an autoscale policy tweak to dedicated-gpu-pool-3 (us-west2) tomorrow 01:00 UTC. Change: increase burst_threshold from 0.15 -> 0.25 and add 45s grace_period to reduce oscillation. Canary on slice-2 for 10m before full cutover. Need someone to own the smoke window and be rollback contact. @akshay_r @liam_s are you available?

akshay_r: I can own smoke. I'll be online. What's the rollback plan and who triggers it? :thumbsup:

maria: Rollback is a single config revert + autoscaler restart. Steps: create a rollback tag and restart the autoscaler deploy. Example commands below. I will push the config to canary at 00:50 UTC.

maria: ```bash
# revert config to previous tag and restart autoscaler
./orchestra rollback-config --pool dedicated-gpu-pool-3 --from-tag pre-burst-2026-03-18
kubectl rollout restart deploy/autoscaler -n inference
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary job created: job/scale-candidate-198765-run1 (will start ~01:00 UTC). Logs forwarded to #eng-releases and to infra-logs.

liam_s: I can monitor SLOs and cost metrics. I'll spin up a short-lived dashboard to track p95, 5xx, and node evictions. Can we agree on a smoke checklist?

maria: Smoke checklist (canary window):
1) canary pods reach expected replica count within 60s
2) no increase in 5xx rate for /v1/serve (>0.5% threshold)
3) latency p95 stays <160ms
4) no container evictions on gpu nodes
5) KV cache hit rate doesn't drop >1pp
Post a short pass/fail for each item here.

sre_ops: I'll watch infra alerts and standby node replacement. Confirmed we have 2 spare nodes in the reserved slice for immediate capacity if needed. Also will disable automated scale-down during the canary to avoid confounding the test.

akshay_r: ACK. Quick smoke commands I'll run after canary:
```bash
# check hpa status
kubectl get hpa -n inference pool-3-hpa
# smoke request to verify latency/5xx
curl -sS -X POST https://us-west2.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-v0","input":"smoke"}' | jq '.latency'
```

maria: Timeline summary: 00:45 UTC reminder and final config check; 00:50 UTC push config to canary; 01:00 UTC canary start (10m); 01:10 UTC quick analysis and decision; 01:20 UTC full rollout if green; 01:40 UTC post-rollout sanity. Abort and rollback immediately on any failed smoke item.

akshay_r: Got it. If smoke fails I'll trigger rollback and page on-call, then post summary here.

liam_s: I'll drop a temporary dashboard link in here ~00:55 UTC and watch latency/cost panels.

maria: Thanks all. Tagging @deploy-bot to set a reminder for 00:45 UTC and to attach the canary job artifact to the thread.

deploy-bot: Reminder set for 00:45 UTC. Canary job: job/scale-candidate-198765-run1. Rollback tag: pre-burst-2026-03-18. I will post job logs to this thread after run completes.

maria: Perfect — will post final config diff before we push. Please react with :eyes: when you read this and are good with the plan.
